[DAY1 12:33:01 - DAY1 12:33:29]
I pick up another puzzle piece and put the pieces down. "Is this a toucan?" I ask. Tasha exclaims, "Oh my god." I hand-recycle some paper and pick the puzzle up again. Lucia says, "So abstract." I study and fiddle with the jigsaw pieces, then set the puzzle down, pull my hand back, nod, and pick it up again. "This is also very abstract," I say. "Whose cow looks like this?" I ask. Shure replies, "A wild buffalo or water buffalo." I'm concentrating on the puzzle. "Then why does the water buffalo have straw underneath it?" I ask. I put the puzzle down, pull my hand back, Alice says, "It's standing on grass," and I step back.

[DAY1 12:32:30 - DAY1 12:33:00]
I type on my phone. "Yeah," I say. "Try again," I add as I hold my phone out to Alice. "Just now, the software didn't update your status," I say, gesturing with my right hand and looking around. "So you weren't recording," I say. "But on the software, it showed I was recording," I add, then I walk to the right. I lie on the table working on a jigsaw puzzle and pick it up, fiddling with pieces. "This is another one," I say. Alice: "I'll go by the current time." "Indeed," I say. Lucia: "So, what is this exactly?" Lucia: "It has five corners." I turn, nod, and lower my head to look at everyone. "Uh, yeah," I say. "You go by the current time," I add.

[DAY1 12:30:00 - DAY1 12:30:29]
I pick up a puzzle piece and fiddle with the jigsaw puzzle, then put the puzzle down and pull my hand back. "No, no, no, no," I say. "Put it inside and see the area," I say. Shure: "Someone's getting anxious." Lucia: "The area might still be about the same." Lucia: "It looks like it." I stand up, then lie back down, propping my left hand on the table and leaning to watch everyone assemble the puzzle. Lucia: "Hey, it's an owl!" Lucia: "So cute!" Alice: "It looks like several people could play together." "Yes, yes, this thing is pretty good," I say. "Okay, everyone, let's play a jigsaw puzzle together," I say. I pick up another piece and fiddle with it; Shure: "It's not a perfect fit." I pull my hand back.
